lines.note: Ge'ez 1 includes the title, lovely dwellings, and the soul's longing; Ge'ez 2 completes Greek 3 with heart and flesh rejoicing.
Ge'ez splits the birds and their nest from the address concerning the altars.
Ge'ez 6 includes Greek 6 and the valley clause of Greek 7; Ge'ez 7 completes Greek 7 and includes Greek 8.
Ge'ez separates the better day in God's courts from the preference for God's house over sinners' dwellings.
Ge'ez 12 contains the opening clauses of Greek 12; Ge'ez 13 completes its promise to the innocent and includes Greek 13.
